## When to use it

Shapes truthful product narratives, message maps, proof, and CTAs for websites, landing pages, pricing, checkout, onboarding, and app flows, and adapts approved stories to video, thumbnail, and social briefs. Use when a surface must move a qualified audience to a credible next action without losing SEO, accessibility, or truth.

Example request:

> Use conversion-storytelling to improve this work using its complete upstream guidance.

Expected result: An output shaped by the complete upstream instructions, source material and the task at hand.

## Install and use

Install this skill from the versioned collection in a supported Agent Skills environment:

```sh
npx skills add https://github.com/theGeekist/skills/tree/v1.10.0 --skill conversion-storytelling
```

Select the intended agent and installation scope when prompted. This CLI installation is separate from ChatGPT plugin registration and mobile availability. Client discovery and activation require their own verification.

Read the [complete skill instructions](../../skills/conversion-storytelling/SKILL.md) and [bundled purpose reference](../../skills/conversion-storytelling/references/GEEKIST-UPSTREAM.md) for the full conditions and exceptions.
